title: modfence.toml (version 1)
description: The repository's `modfence.toml`, as JSON (TOML tables map to objects, `[[x]]` arrays of tables to arrays). Unknown keys are errors. See docs/adrs/0004-config-annotations-and-rules.md.

exclude.description: Gitignore-style globs, relative to the config file, added to the ignore files the walker already honours.

layers.description: Layer names from the highest layer to the lowest. A layer may depend on itself and on any layer below it; an edge from a lower layer to a higher one is an error under the reserved rule id `layers`. Nodes with no `layer` tag, or a tag not listed here, are exempt.

require_reason.description: Whether `arch: ignore[...]` must carry reason="...". Defaults to true.

match.description: Gitignore-style glob over repository-relative paths; tags the matching package, module and symbol nodes.

package.description: Glob over external package names; tags the matching external nodes.

selector.description: AND across keys, OR within a list of values. A key is a tag name, or one of the reserved keys path (glob), package (glob), lang (py|ts|rs) and kind (package|module|symbol|external).

id.description: Unique; `layers` and ids starting with `modfence/` are reserved.

kinds.description: Edge relations the rule applies to. Defaults to ["imports", "binds"]; `calls` must be asked for.
